name: Forehead Height (tr–n)
definition: Direct anthropometric trichion-to-nasion height.
notes: Use calibrated/direct or scale-referenced photography; hairline placement is error-prone.

name: Physiognomic Face Height (tr–gn)
definition: Trichion-to-gnathion total facial height.
notes: Direct anthropometry source; photographic use needs scale and head-pose control.

name: Morphologic Face Height (n–gn)
definition: Nasion-to-gnathion face height.
notes: Normative, not aesthetic.

name: Lower Face Height (sn–gn)
definition: Subnasale-to-gnathion lower face height.
notes: Normative, not aesthetic.

name: Bizygomatic Breadth (zy–zy)
definition: Maximum cheekbone breadth.
notes: 2D photographic agreement is weaker than for many central facial dimensions because zygion is a lateral contour landmark.

name: Bigonial Breadth (go–go)
definition: Mandibular angle breadth.
notes: 2D photogrammetry showed clinically important disagreement for this dimension; do not over-interpret photo-derived mm.

name: Intercanthal Distance (en–en)
definition: Distance between medial canthi.
notes: Population and often sex differences are well documented; measurement method also matters.

name: Eye Fissure Length (en–ex)
definition: Medial-to-lateral canthus length.
notes: Average bilateral values when possible.

name: Biocular Width (ex–ex)
definition: Distance between lateral canthi.
notes: Normative, not aesthetic.

name: Nose Height (n–sn)
definition: Nasion-to-subnasale height.
notes: Normative, not aesthetic.

name: Nose Width (al–al)
definition: Maximum alar breadth.
notes: Substantial inter-population variability; do not normalize to one universal target.

name: Nasal Inclination
definition: Anthropometric nasal inclination angle as defined in Farkas protocol.
notes: Do not substitute another nasal-angle definition without exact landmark equivalence.

name: Mouth Width (ch–ch)
definition: Chelion-to-chelion mouth width.
notes: Expression-sensitive.

name: Ear Height (sa–sba)
definition: Superaurale-to-subaurale ear height.
notes: Ear landmarks can be obscured; head rotation matters.

name: Vertical Eye–Mouth Proportion
definition: Vertical eye-to-mouth distance divided by face length in Pallett et al. stimulus geometry.
landmarks: eye-level reference; mouth; face top/bottom per study
notes: Do not map automatically to FaceIQ Midface Ratio; landmark denominator differs.

name: Horizontal Interocular Proportion
definition: Interocular distance divided by face width in Pallett et al. stimulus geometry.
landmarks: eye centers; face lateral bounds per study
notes: Do not map automatically to FaceIQ Eye Separation Ratio unless definitions match.

name: Mirrored Surface RMSD
definition: Root-mean-square surface distance between a 3D face and its optimally reflected counterpart.
notes: Excellent 3D metric but not recoverable faithfully from a single ordinary 2D photograph.

name: Standard fWHR
definition: Common behavioral-research fWHR: facial width divided by upper-face height.
notes: Do not merge with FaceIQ FWHR because FaceIQ uses a different height denominator.
